name: Hanazono Kikyou
source:
[url=/c40911]Tsubaki's[/url] older twin sister, [url=/c25994]Alice's[/url] master and the dormitory manager of the dorm where the heroines stay at. Like her sister she is a sadistic bisexual, but is not as merciful or kind as Tsubaki.

Despite her refined outlook and the fact she wears a nun's outfit, Kikyou has a twisted personality and enjoys bullying and degrading her students. She also always hides her favorite Bullwhip under her clothes.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=728431]Getchu[/url]]
